title: @petri
description: a net under @petri: the place/transition core of PNML, with what only amk reads under amk

places.description: each place and its initial marking: a count of plain tokens, or a list of labels for a labeled place

transitions.description: the transitions, in the order an enabled one is chosen to fire

arcs.description: place to transition or transition to place, with a weight, the tokens it moves per firing

amk.description: what only amk reads; PNML export leaves it out

strategy.description: who may add to the net's places: default and strict, only the process running the net; open, any process

open.description: the places the environment feeds, each opened with strategy open

pools.description: names usable in arcs as places, each an existing open pool, by the pool's name

steps.description: what each transition runs when it fires, by transition

run.description: a target, or targets run in order; the last one's value is the step's output

bind.description: make variables set before the step runs, each a word

kind.description: goal and goal.maybe run in place; agoal and agoal.maybe run as a job, in flight as a token of <t>.busy; a .maybe failure is an outcome, not fatal

guard.description: a condition on the labels of a transition's inputs, by transition; each input it reads holds one token. a rule name over outcomes, or a label the token must carry

label.description: the label a transition gives the tokens it produces, by transition; without one, the label it took passes on

invariants.description: weighted sums of places, and of <t>.busy counts, that hold whenever no firing is in flight

final.description: the marking a run ends at, by place, or the alternatives; a place left out wants 0

name.description: a place or transition; no name is both, and a place is not named <t>.busy for an agoal transition t

label.description: a labeled token: 1 to 31 bytes, no whitespace, no $, # or backslash
